summary.text: Bryant Wolfin is a Republican state representative who has represented Missouri House District 145 since 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Wolfin owns a convenience store business with his wife and is a former Ste. Genevieve alderman.

paragraphs.text: Bryant Wolfin earned an associate degree in business management from Mineral Area College in 2011.
His career experience includes owning BMW Convenience LLC.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a former Ste. Genevieve alderman and volunteer youth sports coach.
Wolfin took office on January 8, 2025, succeeding Rick Francis, and for 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists him on the Local Government Committee.
In the survey, he said he would work to defend individual liberties and to shrink the role of government.
